role: posthoc uncalibrated experiment-selection priority, not model evaluation
localization: current HPA main/additional and gene-level reliability; caution/multigene hold; member-level UniProt/GO experiments retained; historical L never used as score
epigenetic_reference: EpiFactors2.1 histone/chromatin/Polycomb/DNA categories plus histones; HGNC+canonical accession exact match, RNA-only/generic TF excluded
hub_weight: sqrt(50/(50+partner_degree_in_current9903_graph)); broad-context reference .25, dedicated reference1; primary queue requires dedicated hit
reliability_formula: .6*mean(top3 relation-class weights)+.3*min(1,programme_proxies/3)+.1*any_explicit_context; use core edges when any, otherwise all reported edges; shared identity capped .5
study_caveat: programme proxies, not independent replication counts; same source duplicates never add votes
mechanistic_opportunity: own member mechanism=.15; high-coverage compatible-architecture near relative with experimental function=.25; otherwise unassessed null displayed .5 with 0-1 bounds; no PubMed-count or empty-FUNCTION reward
tractability: min(1,length/100,1000/length); five points maximum; no hard exclusion
unknowns: null+mask, neutral .5 for display, score bounds not CI; zero observed chromatin hits means zero evidence support, not functional negative
redundancy: representative-centred direct stars, sequence identity>=.5 and BOTH coverages>=.8, ordered exact Pfam architecture (or identity>=.9); exact-sequence dependencies always grouped; structural evidence displayed when available, not invented; provisional redundancy, not proven equal functions
